content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint against a company for violating their rights. The Chief Commissioner, as part of the Central Authority, receives the complaint and delegates the powers of general superintendence, direction and control in respect of all administrative matters of the Central Authority to a Commissioner.
content.outcome: The Chief Commissioner, as part of the Central Authority, exercises the powers of general superintendence, direction and control in respect of all administrative matters of the Central Authority.
